node.title: Re^5: converting context free grammar to BNF
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [nido203],

The reason your result looks like that is because of the $::RD_AUTOACTION = q { [ @item ] }; directive, which creates the arrayrefs. Also, does create objects (blessed references), which are not always easy to convert to JSON. [mod://Parse::RecDescent] does provide a hash for each item, so you could put this at the top of your grammar: and you'll get hashrefs. However, those will still contain all of the raw parse results. If you want to customize it, you'll have to look into writing custom actions that return only the values you are interested in. There's of course the [mod://Parse::RecDescent] docs (especially the section "Actions"), but also this: [id://108182]

Hope this helps,
-- Hauke D
